I replied to Dana in a thread on her message in #north-team: the ticket for the hub replacement in Zoom Room B is #4092.

The source is Ilse's message in #north-random on Oct 13 at 11:55. Dana is a member of that channel. Ilse said IT has #4092 open to replace the hub, and warned not to unplug the main power brick under the table because that resets the Polycom. I passed that warning on too.

Dana also sent a private guess about the ticket number in her DM with me. I left it out of the channel reply.
